format: Single continuous real-browser capture of the live guided demo (Chrome screencast), scripted clicks timed to narration, a visible click indicator, burned-in captions. No mockups, no edited product states.
voice: en-US-GuyNeural; synthesized narration, not the entrant speaking
source_pdf_note: The source page shown is rebuilt with the recorded run's own generator and text; the quote lands at the exact recorded highlight boxes. Not the byte-identical original (PyMuPDF writes a random file ID).
export_note: Evidence report downloaded from the live UI during the take and shown as downloaded; reviewer decision is browser-local only.

chapters.title: The problem
chapters.text: AI can find the right sentence in a document, and still draw the wrong conclusion.

chapters.title: A real recorded example
chapters.text: Here's a real example from our recorded Meta Muse tests, using a fictional applicant.

chapters.title: The requirement
chapters.text: The job requires someone who personally negotiated supplier agreements.

chapters.title: The quote
chapters.text: The CV mentions those agreements. But look carefully. The applicant says their procurement director negotiated them. The applicant only prepared comparison notes.

chapters.title: The correction
chapters.text: Meta Muse identified a conflict. EvidenceTrail checked the original evidence, and corrected the finding: this CV does not establish that the applicant personally negotiated those agreements.

chapters.title: The source page
chapters.text: We can inspect the source page, and see exactly where the quotation came from.

chapters.title: Source provenance
chapters.text: The source PDF shown is a documented reconstruction of the original test input, not the byte-identical original.

chapters.title: No hiring decisions
chapters.text: And crucially, EvidenceTrail doesn't make hiring decisions.

chapters.title: Human control
chapters.text: A human reviewer can request clarification and record a note, without changing the underlying finding.

chapters.title: The evidence report
chapters.text: The result is a readable evidence report that makes the AI's interpretation transparent and reviewable.

chapters.title: Closing
chapters.text: Meta Muse interprets. EvidenceTrail verifies. Humans decide.
